target.name: Unone generic diagnostics typed API recovery and cost
target.scope: Public SDK generic structured spatial diagnostics, canonical typed records/example, independent geometry authoring/repair and repeated CPU cost measurement. Supplementary informed synthetic fault matrix, actual native GPU and fresh WASM CPU/WebGPU main/Worker regressions. Excludes gameplay, rendered appearance, real driver/device-loss, universal speedup and cross-device certification.
target.version: game0.1.0; spatial/diagnostic/profile api_version1; USB1; official Luau0.734
target.revision: checkout7b9424cf42d0409633c9ce782503075bd09018f9 with preserved concurrent dirty changes; SDK CLI SHA256d59c051d00ad47616978b6c4352a67092555baecfb090fb6b3442ca929c3e028; selected source archive and 62 hashes bound this task.
target.environment: Windows x64; preinstalled toolchains; NVIDIA GeForce RTX5080 native Vulkan and Edge155.0.4283.62 WebGPU; final release SDK-v2 and fresh hash-verified WASM. Completed2026-10-24 Asia/Taipei. No game edit/install/commit/push.

limitations: Aggregate is informed/retest. Only the separately sealed fresh SDK-only author is blind; source review, owner probes, replay and semantic review are informed. Author did not read example main.luau, repo implementation/tests, rubric or prior audits.

53 ordered author ledger events plus initial bootstrap; events include reads/writes/copies/identity/seal, not 53 CLI calls. There are27 top-level runner child processes; nested benchmark calls are separately counted, not double-counted. Engine-internal analyzer launches are opaque. No token/time-to-user estimate is inferred.

First strict check passed at event27. First runtime delivery28 completed but external verifier30 passed12/13: stale-index probe hit per-tick quota first. Author independently moved the probe; strict34, runtime35 and external36 passed13/13. A Windows Node --import invocation error and search miss are retained. No undocumented API/signature guesses.
Counter gameplay_source_repairs:1 refers only to the synthetic trial Luau probe-placement correction. No actual game content was used or modified.

Author executed CPU geometry and small16x4/large4096x128 benchmarks with3 warmups+9 retained samples. GPU, Web/Worker and host bridge/setup were not blind-authored; their actual runs here are supplementary informed regressions.

Fault matrix uses supplied fake executors/hosts/devices and malformed envelopes. Actual GPU normal execution is separately verified. No actual hardware/driver device-loss event was exercised. Reload retains the executor and cannot repair a broken device; terminal recovery may require a new runtime and working executor.

Native direct executor benchmark is debug; SDK CPU is release. Their timings are not a matched end-to-end speed comparison. Kernel timestamps remain unavailable with explicit reason. Host/setup/bridge/manager/binding phases overlap; no additive kernel, crossover, frame-rate or universal speedup claim.

Returned records are detached snapshots. Official Luau0.734 still accepts some dynamic string-index/typeof-table alias mutations despite named fields remaining typed. Treat records as read-only; this task does not claim universal alias/type soundness. Empty arrays/plain objects and typed numeric/record arrays are actually checked.

Structured diagnostics cover input/manager/executor/host failures; VM OOM, buffer allocation and output encoding failures are excluded. Structured paths are one-based, runtime frame is zero-based and legacy error strings retain old wording/indexing. recovery.action is human guidance; branch on code/retry/flags.

Combined Chinese search 空間查詢 錯誤診斷 returns no matches in the owner public probe; structured full-index fallback recovers. Fresh author also recovered scene entity via entity. Search combinations are not universally recognized.

All six actual captures share62 selected subjects, including the sealed final project and inspected independent oracle. Selected46 exact source copies are retained, but neither this archive nor pinned local binaries attest a full dependency graph, clean build or authorship. The87-file local blind seal is integrity evidence, not an external signature.

Previous audits remain unchanged. Different SDK and expanded task scope mean this score is not a formal numeric before/after comparison. The ten questions assess this scope, not the entire engine or any game.

firstSuccessStep28 denotes the first completed runtime delivery, not complete external acceptance; final independent13/13 acceptance occurs at ledger event36. No authored any/casts refers to the independent trial code, not unrelated pre-existing declarations in the canonical API block.

dimensions.title: 用途與起點
dimensions.question: 陌生 AI 從入口能否說明工具解決什麼、不解決什麼，以及下一個正確操作？
dimensions.answer: Fresh SDK-only author found the generic sphere-batch API, canonical types, CPU default, fixed-tick delivery and engine/caller ownership boundary.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep SDK entry links and generic ownership explicit.

dimensions.title: 能力與限制發現
dimensions.question: 如何查到目前版本真正可用的功能、相依條件與未實作能力，而不是猜 API？
dimensions.answer: Public search, descriptors and complete packaged docs expose diagnostic fields, limits, query forms, typed observations and CPU/GPU availability.
dimensions.nextAction: Improve generic multi-term/synonym discovery in a separate bounded change; keep complete-index fallback.

dimensions.title: 可執行操作契約
dimensions.question: 只靠可發現的契約及最小例子能否完成代表任務？輸入欄位、回傳及副作用是否明確？
dimensions.answer: Fresh author independently implemented nearest/overlap/sweep, no-hit and empty batches, typed publication, invalid replacement/repair and resource delivery through public contracts.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain first failure and final replay; obtain a fresh author again after future contract changes.

dimensions.title: 上下文與需求真相
dimensions.question: 是否保留 ID、關聯、版本、來源與待決事項？AI 能否取得必要脈絡而不把推測當需求？
dimensions.answer: Frozen batch results retain source version1 after atomic rejection; repaired index is version2, and already submitted work survives index destruction until next-tick take.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep version/lifetime/snapshot semantics explicit without implying save persistence.

dimensions.title: 結果與狀態觀察
dimensions.question: 如何查到實際變更、進度、完成、失敗與限制？是否把已送出、執行成功、人類驗收分開？
dimensions.answer: Complete canonical info/result/profile/diagnostic records publish directly; no-hit/empty/typed empty arrays remain[], typed numbers/records work and plain{} remains an object.
dimensions.nextAction: Preserve array/object, detached-copy and read-only observer regressions.

dimensions.title: 具體錯因與修復
dimensions.question: 故意做錯一次：回應是否指出錯誤碼、欄位或物件、實際值與預期、具體原因及可採取的修復？修正後重跑是否成功？
dimensions.answer: Invalid second body radius=-2 returns SPATIAL_INPUT_INVALID, spatial.update, bodies[2].radius, actual=-2, expected finite0..1000000 and machine retry/terminal flags; correcting radius succeeds.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain stable facts/retry policy and host-accessible terminal causes; keep human messages compatible.

dimensions.title: 重試、衝突與恢復
dimensions.question: 重複請求、狀態過時、失去回覆或中斷時，AI 能否判斷安全重試、續接或需人類介入，不重複副作用？
dimensions.answer: Early take retries next tick, invalid update corrects without partial mutation, destroyed indices and consumed tickets reject reuse safely.
dimensions.nextAction: Preserve recoverable versus terminal distinction; validate real interruption separately when required.

dimensions.title: 權限與作用範圍
dimensions.question: 讀寫、目標專案／裝置、批准與外部副作用是否可查且實際受到限制？以一個越界操作驗證。
dimensions.answer: Generic geometry calls affect only their bounded data/resources; same-tick access, destroyed-index submit and consumed-ticket reuse reject, while unrelated synthetic entity remains exactly unchanged.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep geometry independent of gameplay movement, targeting and collision responses.

dimensions.title: 效能與成本定位
dimensions.question: 能否觀察這類工具相關的耗時、資源或成本及瓶頸？無法量測是否明說而不回傳假零？不要求每種工具都有 GPU 指標。
dimensions.answer: Public SDK tool performs warmups and repeated samples with p50/p95, separate manager/executor/Lua input/output scopes; official host adds setup and UTF-8 bridge phase/byte counters.
dimensions.nextAction: Measure representative caller workloads before thresholds; retain warmup/distribution/build/scope metadata and unavailable reasons.

dimensions.title: 版本與可重現驗證
dimensions.question: 能否保留版本指紋、環境、輸入、輸出及可重跑步驟？如何知道修改後原失敗案例確實已修复？
dimensions.answer: Six actual recorder captures share62 selected hashes and complete without timeout/truncation/source change;46 exact selected text sources,87 sealed author files and pinned binary/analyzer/runtime identities are retained.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep this audit immutable; use a new directory and fresh author for future first-use claims.

issues.summary: Some natural-language multi-term search queries return no matches despite a discoverable public API.
issues.cause: Observed owner query 空間查詢 錯誤診斷 has matches=[]; actual complete-index fallback finds spatial descriptors. Fresh author scene entity also misses while entity succeeds. These observations bound the search-matching gap; its algorithmic root cause was not established in this task.
issues.fix: Follow-up generic API search matching/synonym improvement with these preserved cases, maintaining truthful no-match output and complete-index fallback. No game vocabulary or gameplay behavior is required.
issues.verification: Preserve current raw query outputs; after any matching change rerun these exact misses, narrower successful queries and unrelated negative queries, then a fresh discovery trial.

telemetry.note: Plugin wall time only, not target performance. No target commands or probes executed.
